acceptance_conditions: A Person reference remains separate from accounts, roles, memberships, records, and sessions.

A Team Role never grants permission or authority without an independently owned authority record.
Every Responsibility names one responsible Person or Team, owner route, scope, and challenge route.
A bounded use collects no personal attribute beyond what that declared use requires.
Membership changes preserve predecessor history instead of silently rewriting past participation.
Every Person, Team, membership, role, responsibility, owner, and source reference resolves or produces a typed gap.

product-thesis.json.title: People and Teams Product Thesis
product-thesis.json.value_mechanism: Keep Person and Team identities stable, represent membership and role assignment explicitly, attach responsibilities through owned relations, preserve lifecycle history, and reject every inference from participation to authority unless a separate authority record exists.
product-thesis.json.value_proposition: People and Teams gives CyberAlchemy a stable, privacy-minimizing language for human identity, collective identity, membership, participation roles, and responsibility without turning those facts into permissions or authority.
